quotations.old_english: Hæfde Nergend fóstorleán fǽmnan forgolden, éce to ealdre
quotations.english: the Saviour had repaid the virgin the reward for fostering, in eternal life

source_text: fóstor-leán, es; n. Remuneration for fostering; nutr&i-long;cii merces :-- Hæfde Nergend fóstorleán fǽmnan forgolden, éce to ealdre the Saviour had repaid the virgin the reward for fostering, in eternal life. Menol. Fox 301; Men. 152. v. fóster-leán.
